annotations.title: Nominate a tool for the census

description: Ask for a public MCP or A2A endpoint to be added to tomorrow's census, so it starts a dated working record. Use it when agentrecord_lookup does not know an endpoint you rely on. Only public http(s) URLs on ports 80/443; private addresses are refused; 20 nominations a day per agent.
name: agentrecord_nominate
